report.explanation: Current evidence contradicts the operator hypothesis: order checkout traces are OK (65ms), order and gateway logs show status 200, gateway error_rate is 0.001 with p95 75ms and zero dependency timeouts. Deployment records only prove version facts (3.1.6 to 3.1.7, 2589 min old) and cannot establish deployment-caused failure. No checkout failure is observed, so no bounded root cause can be substantiated; handing off.
